high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "sarcastic_us." The post features two side-by-side photographs of a woman standing at what appears to be a formal event or conference. She is dressed professionally in a black turtleneck sweater and a beige pencil skirt with a slit on the left side. She holds a piece of paper in her right hand. In the background, there are two men seated at a table. One man is wearing a suit and tie, while the other is also in formal attire. There is a podium to the left of the woman, suggesting that she might have been speaking or presenting.
